【原视频简介】
We discovered a method to grow huge crystals from Epsom salt.

It seems like there are no other tutorials on how to do this - other methods always give small needle-like Epsom salt crystals.

The key is to use the right concentration! Depending on your room temperature, the concentration you should use might be different.

If you'd like a step-by-step written guide, my son has created an excellent blog post on this topic: https://crystalverse.com/epsom-salt-crystals

---

MATERIALS

I bought my materials in Malaysia, but the items below are similar ones available on Amazon — they work just as well if you’d like to try this experiment yourself.

• Epsom salt: https://amzn.to/444A8tw
• Electric burner: https://amzn.to/47MeHi8
• Nylon fishing line (clear, 0.14 mm): https://amzn.to/3XlgZjo
• 250 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/49P4mob
• 2000 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/43qzmXP
• Precision tweezers: https://amzn.to/47AS0yB
• Digital scale: https://amzn.to/4olYTsy

These are Amazon affiliate links — I may earn a small commission if you purchase through them, at no extra cost to you.

Thank you for supporting this channel!
